y1: Sprint planning shouldn't drag on all afternoon. Meet Open Planning Poker: free, open-source estimation for agile teams.
y2: Create a room in seconds. No sign-up, no passwords. Name your game, pick a deck, and you're in.
y3: Paste your backlog, and every line becomes a ticket.
y4: Then share the link, or let your team scan the QR code.
y5: Everyone joins from their own browser, on a laptop or on a phone.
y6: Start a shared timer, and everyone picks a card in secret. You see who has voted, but not what they chose, so nobody anchors the team.
y7: When the team is ready, all the cards turn over at the same moment.
y8: You get the average, the median and the spread, with a hint on who should explain their vote. Then the host records the final estimate.
y9: Turn on auto-reveal, run async voting before the meeting, and export results to PDF or CSV. Switch to dark mode or another language, and keep every sprint in a team room, with a velocity chart.
y10: Open Planning Poker. Free and open source. Start estimating today, at app dot open planning poker dot com.
